hooks.text: 乘客不开心会把列车长扔下车
hooks.excerpt: The passengers on your train will work diligently at your command, but be careful: if you don't manage their happiness properly, they might throw you off the train.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 途经城市用重吊无人机扩充车厢牌组
hooks.excerpt: Each time you pass through a city, you'll be able to add new train cars by launching a heavy lift drone. Be careful with each choice you make. If you are lucky, you'll be able to build a better, more synergized, happily-ever-after train deck, but it won't always go as you planned.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 穿越毒区并逃离身后逼近的暴风雪
hooks.excerpt: You'll have to pass through toxic areas, and a severe storm is brewing behind you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 难度曲线较陡，理解玩法需要数小时。

excerpts.excerpt: It took me a few hours for me to clock on to what the game wanted from me, and the difficulty curve is definitely pretty steep.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分协同明显优于其他协同。

excerpts.excerpt: Some of the synergies are just always going to be better than others.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: it does give you a good sense of challenge, particularly when you're starting out.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 管理与策略玩法简单而有娱乐性。

excerpts.excerpt: A simple and entertaining management / strategy game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
